name: @561-group/horsetail-fennel
description: Horsetail — the 561-group computer's native language, a paraconsistent settling Lisp where `eval` IS `settle` and top (⊤) is a bindable HELD value. Recovered from the last computer/ source tree before its 2026-06-06 archival (git cd6b4e97704), where it had been cut from @561-group/computer's later 0.0.1->0.0.2 scope reduction (see that package's README 'coherent subset' policy) and left as a documented stub in @red-cup-engineering/tsander's horsetail-hook.mjs (`@561-group/computer/horsetail does not exist`). Recovered here as its own package rather than re-inserted into @561-group/computer, per that package's stated policy of shipping only the subset exercised by active consumers. Ships horsetail itself plus the minimal principal/distribution/process-runtime/typed-filepath-addressing-system slices horsetail's evaluator and its `as`-form authority test depend on at runtime (support tiles, not full re-instatements of those larger, still-unrecovered subsystems).

scripts.test: node horsetail/tests/run.mjs && node horsetail/tests/parity.mjs && node principal/tests/principal.test.mjs
